personality_one_liner: A joyful, colorful ride-planning and transit experience that transforms everyday urban travel into a delightful, friendly adventure.

spacing.rule: Generous touchable padding, chunky rounded cards, and delightful vertical rhythm designed for effortless one-handed reach.

do's: Use frosted glass on sticky search header over map background
Use translucent blurred cards for ride selection sheets
dont's: Do not blur dense form inputs or primary ride buttons

screens.name: Auth
screens.purpose: Joyful entry point supporting Google sign-in, Email/password, and Phone verification with SMS code.

states.loading: Checking credentials with friendly bounce animation
states.empty: Enter your details to start riding
states.error: Invalid login or code. Please tap retry.

screens.layout: Warm cream background with playful header illustration, tabbed auth selector for Google, Email, and Phone with SMS verification steps.

screens.name: Home / Map
screens.purpose: Interactive map dashboard showing live nearby shuttle buses, joyful sightseeing spots, and quick ride booking options.

states.empty: No rides nearby. Try expanding your radius!
states.error: Unable to load map GPS. Tap to retry.

screens.layout: Full-bleed map view with floating frosted glass search bar at top, quick destination chips, and bottom sliding sheet for ride categories (Shuttle, Sightseeing, Taxi).

screens.name: Ride Booking
screens.purpose: Customizable pickup and dropoff selector with seeded sightseeing destinations, vehicle options, and fare estimates.

states.loading: Calculating best routes and happy drivers...
states.empty: Select pickup and destination to see rides.
states.error: Could not fetch route fares. Retry connection.

screens.layout: Single column form with distinct pickup and dropoff pill inputs, horizontal vehicle selector cards with real logos/illustrations, and sticky bottom primary CTA.

screens.name: Live Trip Status
screens.purpose: Real-time driver and vehicle tracking with animated progress, driver contact, and arrival countdown.

states.empty: No active trip found. Book a ride to see live tracking.

screens.layout: Map top half with animated route line, bottom sheet displaying driver card, vehicle badge, ETA countdown timer, and emergency/chat buttons.

screens.name: Sightseeing Itinerary
screens.purpose: Curated sightseeing experiences and custom itineraries for joyful urban exploration.

states.empty: No itineraries saved yet. Tap explore to add spots!
states.error: Failed to load sightseeing data. Tap to retry.

screens.layout: Magazine-style scrolling feed with gorgeous hero photo cards, tag pills, and instant 'Book Experience' action.

screens.name: Ride History
screens.purpose: Past trips, booked shuttles, and booking confirmations log with receipt summaries and re-booking.

states.empty: No past rides yet. Your adventure log starts today!
states.error: Could not retrieve ride history. Retry.

screens.layout: Clean vertical list of trip cards with date badges, vehicle thumbnail, route summary, and rating indicator.

instructions_to_main_agent: Adhere strictly to the Tactile / Playful LIGHT personality (Fredoka display font, Plus Jakarta Sans body, coral/orange accent #FF6B35, warm cream background #FFFDF9).
Ensure all touch targets are >= 44x44pt and cards fill horizontal space cleanly with md/lg margins.
Implement loading, empty, and error states for every data screen.
Provide sticky bottom CTAs on booking and ride setup screens with frosted glass containers.
Use real PNG logos or clean image slots for branded vehicles and destinations with gradient scrims on all image cards.
